course_name_original: Optoelectronic and Laser Devices in Industry
course_name_en: Optoelectronic and Laser Devices in Industry

learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with complex theoretical, methodological and apparatus problems in recent coherent and incoherent optics and optoelectronics.
Introduce students to different application areas of optic and optoelectronics devices and systems.
Create skills for experimental investigation in applied optics and optoelectronics.
Solve practical problems connected with the application of modern optoelectronics and optic apparatus in instrument building.

syllabus_topics: Basic properties and characteristics of optical radiation
Coherent optoelectronics: light amplification and generation
Coherent light propagation through the atmosphere and in optical waveguides
Main application areas of optical, optoelectronics and laser systems and devices in industry
Elemental composition and working principles of optic and optoelectronic devices
Basic parameters and specific application areas of optic and optoelectronic devices
Main principles of optical system design

assessment_methods.method: Knowledge on the material of the laboratory classes tested regularly
Written exam (two theoretical questions and one laboratory exercise)

assessment_rules: The final mark is formed after a discussion with the student. At the exam, students answer two theoretical questions and do one laboratory exercise.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
